words.prose: {{ar:وَدُّوا}} ({{tr:waddū}}) opens the ayah by exposing a completed plural wish before the requested action is named. Its 3mp ending keeps the deniers from 68:8 present as an implicit subject, while the verb governs the following {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) clause so both later compromise verbs remain the desired but unrealized content of what they wanted. The {{ar:و د د}} ({{tr:w-d-d}}) root makes that wish more than a neutral request or strategy: the opponents are emotionally invested in a loved outcome, even though the local Form I perfect keeps the pressure as an internal desire rather than an overt causative act of making something beloved. The opening therefore moves from the prohibition of 68:8 into diagnostic disclosure: the ayah shows why obedience would serve a desired concession. Even the compressed doubled dāl at the start helps the sentence launch with a tight pressure that is then carried into the repeated d-h-n verbs.

words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) is the small hinge that turns the opponents' desire into an unrealized scenario. After {{ar:وَدُّوا}} ({{tr:waddū}}), it works as the content marker for what they wished, while retaining optative or counterfactual force: the softening is desired, not reported as achieved. Its scope reaches through the attached response verb, so {{ar:تُدْهِنُ}} ({{tr:tudhinu}}) and {{ar:فَيُدْهِنُونَ}} ({{tr:fa-yudhinūna}}) remain one wished unit rather than two separate events. Because the particle stands as its own clipped word, the reader can hear and see the pivot from hidden motive into projected action.

words.prose: {{ar:تُدْهِنُ}} ({{tr:tudhinu}}) is the projected act the opponents want from the addressee: an imperfect 2ms Form IV verb inside the unrealized {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) frame. Its intransitive behavior is decisive. The point is not that the addressee oils an external object, but that he would become pliant or soften in stance. The {{ar:د ه ن}} ({{tr:d-h-n}}) field makes that softening concrete: oil, smoothing, and surface coating give the compromise image its texture, while the local social frame narrows the sense to morally charged accommodation rather than literal smearing. The feebleness and light-contact pressures sharpen the payoff further: this is imagined as a weakening of firmness, not balanced negotiation or forceful submission. The rare finite Form IV use concentrates a small root family around this demand; concrete uses at 23:20 and 55:37 and the compromiser role at 56:81 help explain the field, without overriding the local grammar. As the middle beat, {{ar:تُدْهِنُ}} ({{tr:tudhinu}}) also sets up the mirrored plural response, so one hypothetical concession becomes the hinge of the whole bargain. Its repeated d-h-n sequence, moving through a light dental, breathy h, and nasal n, gives the two compromise verbs a shared sound texture that fits the smoothing image.

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) is the hinge that keeps the second d-h-n verb from becoming a loose repetition. It coordinates the response with {{ar:تُدْهِنُ}} ({{tr:tudhinu}}) while carrying resultative force: their softening follows because of the first hypothetical softening. Its immediate sequence value compresses the exchange, and its attachment to {{ar:يُدْهِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yudhinūna}}) makes the response arrive already bound to the cause. The particle therefore turns the mirrored verbs into a dependency chain inside the wished scenario.

words.prose: {{ar:يُدْهِنُونَ}} ({{tr:yudhinūna}}) closes the ayah with the deniers' promised side of the bargain. The 3mp ending routes the subject back to the same plural group whose wish opened the ayah, while the attached {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) prevents their response from reading as free-standing goodwill. Like {{ar:تُدْهِنُ}} ({{tr:tudhinu}}), it is Form IV and intransitive, so their act is also stance-softening or compromise rather than oiling an object. The same oil-coating and dissembling field colors their response as surface accommodation, and the singular-to-plural shift makes the asymmetry visible: one addressee would have to bend first, and many would answer. The final long plural ending gives the ayah's landing to their contingent response, while the variant mood pressure keeps the closure from becoming independent of the prior concession.

topics.reason: The same root and form recur from 2ms to 3mp, and {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa-}}) orders the pair so the mirror is reciprocal but not symmetrical.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 projects a wished-for event, while the conditional particle and the causally linked repetition of the d-h-n verb at words 3-4 make the addressee move first.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opponents do not merely want simultaneous moderation. They desire an asymmetric protocol: the addressee supplies the initiating softening or dissembling, and only then do they answer with the same named action.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch supplies desire for an event to occur and makes the first concession the opponents' intended outcome.
The compromise-and-dissembling branch supplies pliant outward dealing and serves as the action deliberately mirrored across the causal link.

changed_reading.before: They want both sides to compromise.
changed_reading.after: They want a concession protocol whose entry price is the addressee's prior softening; their matching softness is conditional and strategically second.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same d-h-n root occurs in both verbal slots at words 3-4, allowing its social softening and material coating branches to remain active together.
baseline_models.mechanism: Each side can apply a smooth public coating without changing what lies underneath. Repetition yields two polished surfaces, not necessarily convergence of interiors.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch turns bilateral coating into the sought arrangement rather than an accidental appearance.
The oil-and-smearing branch supplies a literal surface layer and models public smoothness that need not penetrate inward.
The dissembling branch converts the physical coating into managed agreement that can conceal a contrary interior.

changed_reading.before: Compromise brings the parties substantively closer.
changed_reading.after: The requested reciprocity may only make both exteriors smooth while preserving the disagreement beneath them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled d-h-n verb at words 3-4 carries a branch of slight wetting confined to the ground's face and another of diminished yield or strength.
baseline_models.mechanism: The proposal can be calibrated below the threshold of substantive change: one side supplies a thin, visible concession and receives an equally thin response. The symmetry is quantitative but intentionally minimal.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch makes the minimal change an actively solicited outcome.
The slight-rain branch supplies a merely superficial wetting and models a concession visible at the surface but too small to transform the ground.
The low-yield and weakness branch sets the proposed exchange at reduced force rather than full surrender.

changed_reading.before: They request a broad compromise.
changed_reading.after: They may be testing whether a token, surface-level dilution can be elicited and then matched with no more than token reciprocity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated d-h-n verb at words 3-4 also carries the image of a smooth road, while the causal link assigns route-making to the addressee first.
baseline_models.mechanism: Softening removes friction from a course of action. Their own easy movement follows once the addressee has made the route passable.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch makes friction removal the desired enabling event.
The smooth-road branch supplies a traversable surface and assigns compromise the function of clearing resistance from a route.

changed_reading.before: The requested softening changes the tone between two parties.
changed_reading.after: The first softening may be infrastructural: it makes a course easy for the opponents to travel, after which their response follows.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can activate both affection and wishing, and its desired clause makes relational warmth contingent on the repeated d-h-n action.
baseline_models.mechanism: The offer is affiliative recruitment: warmth and mutuality are held out, but only after the addressee alters his outward dealing. Affection therefore functions as leverage rather than an unconditional bond.

activation_trace.role: The affection branch supplies the relational attraction that makes accommodation feel like admission into mutual warmth.
The wishing branch converts affection from a static feeling into a desired future arrangement.
The accommodating branch supplies the condition placed on access to that reciprocal warmth.

changed_reading.before: The opponents simply desire doctrinal or rhetorical compromise.
changed_reading.after: They also offer conditional belonging: soften first, and relational warmth will be returned.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier character cue distinguishes an inwardly settled disposition from a smooth exterior. That contrast strengthens the coating model: the requested alteration targets presentation and would create a split between durable character and cosmetic public behavior.

activation_trace.role: The coating branch supplies the applied exterior that can be changed without remaking the person beneath it.
The dissembling branch makes the exterior-interior split socially operative as accommodation that displays other than what is held inwardly.
The inward-disposition branch supplies a stable interior and anchors what a cosmetic concession would fail to alter.
The smooth-surface branch provides an explicit exterior counterpart and sharpens the difference between surface polish and inward character.

structural_cues: 68:4 establishes character before 68:9 introduces the requested behavioral alteration.
The focus repeats the alteration on two actors but never states that either interior changes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward disposition, smooth surface, coating, and dissembling; I infer that the request targets exterior display rather than character itself. A live alternative is ordinary social compromise with no deliberate interior-exterior split.

changed_reading.before: They want him to become more accommodating as a person.
changed_reading.after: They want a cosmetic layer over an already established character, producing compliant display without inward revision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Contextual testing branches recast the requested first concession as an assay. A small softening is not necessarily the negotiated endpoint; it is evidence that the stance can be worked, with the opponents' response supplied only after the test succeeds.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch supplies the opponents' interest in obtaining a diagnostic event.
The slight surface change supplies a low-cost probe whose occurrence can reveal whether deeper movement is possible.
The assay branch supplies testing that exposes the quality of a material or person and makes the first concession diagnostic.
The trial branch supplies a second context mechanism in which an event reveals an otherwise hidden condition.

structural_cues: The focus follows the question of who is under testing and precedes a narrative introduced through doubled testing language.
The addressee's action is grammatically prior to the opponents' response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, trial, and a slight first change; I infer that the opponents treat the first concession as information about future malleability. The live alternative is that they seek a bounded exchange rather than data for further pressure.

changed_reading.before: They propose a completed reciprocal bargain.
changed_reading.after: They solicit a small first move as an assay of whether the addressee can be moved further, with reciprocity serving as the test's inducement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding path, errancy, and obedience cues activate the smooth-road baseline. The requested softening would remove resistance from a course already characterized as misdirected and would make the self easier to lead along it.

activation_trace.role: The smooth-road branch supplies frictionless passage and makes the first concession function as route preparation.
The accommodating branch translates physical passability into social and rhetorical compliance.
The deviation branch marks the relevant course as movement away from right direction rather than a neutral midpoint.
The extended-road branch supplies the path on which reduced friction would have consequences beyond tone.
The making-easy-for-action branch supplies internal readiness and turns a smooth route into eased compliance.

structural_cues: 68:7 names direction and misdirection, 68:8 blocks obedience, and 68:9 immediately states the desired concession.
The focus makes the addressee's smoothing precede the opponents' movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a smooth road, a path, deviation, and self-easing for action; I infer that concession paves their course through the addressee's resistance. An alternative is purely interpersonal moderation unrelated to directional allegiance.

changed_reading.before: Softening creates a neutral meeting point.
changed_reading.after: Softening first paves an already misdirected course and makes compliance with its travelers easier.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cutting and paring branches transform smoothness from courtesy into subtraction. The desired accommodation can be read as shaving a fixed boundary little by little until what resisted passage has become level and traversable.

activation_trace.role: The smooth-road branch supplies the leveled result toward which repeated small removals can work.
The compromise branch supplies the social operation whose hidden material analogue is progressive shaving.
The cutting-and-paring branch supplies removal from something hard for the purpose of making it even.
The severing branch supplies decisive subtraction and warns that apparent smoothing can culminate in separation.
The cutting branch extends the subtraction image into the later moral classification and keeps boundary loss active.

structural_cues: The surah opens with a tool formed by paring and later repeats harvest-cutting language.
The focus places the addressee's smoothing before the opponents' matching action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paring-to-level, severing, cutting, and a smooth route; I infer a process in which concessions plane down a boundary. The live alternative is that these material branches are independent and the focus denotes only social tact.

changed_reading.before: Compromise bends a position without necessarily reducing it.
changed_reading.after: Each apparently smooth concession may shave material from a boundary until resistance itself has been cut away.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches separately supply peace, truthful affection, and removal of estrangement. Their availability sharpens d-h-n as accommodation that may imitate those goods without accomplishing them; the conditional warmth in the focus remains unverified.

activation_trace.role: The affection branch supplies the warmth being offered and makes its sincerity a live question.
The dissembling branch supplies outward accord that can stop short of repairing the relation.
The peace-against-war branch supplies substantive cessation of hostility as a contrast to cosmetic accommodation.
The truthful-affection branch supplies a criterion the focus offer has not yet met: warmth congruent with the relationship beneath it.
The reconciliation branch supplies actual removal of estrangement and marks what reciprocal soft display alone may leave untouched.

structural_cues: Vocabulary for peace, truthfulness, and repaired relation occurs separately from the focus's mirrored accommodation.
The focus makes warmth contingent on the addressee's prior action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct branches for peace, truthful affection, reconciliation, and dissembling; I infer a contrast between genuine repair and performed accord. The terms could overlap in ordinary discourse, so the contrast is diagnostic rather than a strict lexical exclusion.

changed_reading.before: The opponents invite mutual peace.
changed_reading.after: They invite a performance of accord whose warmth is conditional and whose underlying estrangement may remain unrepaired.

context_deltas.mechanism: The second d-h-n verb functions like promised consideration for an advance concession. The immediate portrait of habitual oath-making and the later demand for a binding oath and guarantor expose the asymmetry: the addressee pays first while the opponents' return remains unsecured.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch supplies solicitation of the addressee's advance performance.
The repeated accommodation branch supplies both the requested payment and the promised return while preserving their unequal order.
The oath branch supplies performative assurance, while its immediate placement under a negative command makes such assurance suspect.
The sworn-oath branch supplies the stronger form of commitment later demanded but absent from the focus exchange.
The guarantor branch supplies enforceable backing and highlights that the opponents' reciprocal verb names no guarantor.

structural_cues: A habitual oath-maker is introduced immediately after the focus.
Later questions demand both a binding oath and someone who will answer for the claim.
The focus orders the addressee's action before the opponents' response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oath and guarantor branches; I treat the second verb as an implicit promise exchanged for prior performance. A live alternative is that the causal link predicts an immediate response rather than offering a deferred or unreliable contract.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes a dependable bilateral exchange.
changed_reading.after: It records solicitation of an advance concession against a performative but unsecured promise of reciprocity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following portrait and garden sequence repeatedly activate withholding, contraction, interrupted productivity, and deprivation. That pattern weakens any innocent symmetry: the opponents can release only enough softness to obtain the first concession while retaining control over the good being sought.

activation_trace.role: The slight surface wetting supplies a token return compatible with continued withholding of substantive benefit.
The dissembling branch allows the return gesture to look reciprocal while preserving an asymmetrical intention.
The withholding-from-giving branch supplies a social disposition that can ration reciprocity.
The contraction-and-refusal branch supplies coordinated closure behind an outwardly purposeful approach.
The interrupted-yield branch supplies a material analogue for an exchange that displays moisture yet withholds productive flow.
The deprivation branch supplies the eventual result of a withholding strategy and destabilizes the promise of equal benefit.

structural_cues: The character portrait following 68:9 foregrounds withholding good.
The garden narrative turns coordinated exclusion into the agents' own deprivation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withholding, contraction, loss of productive flow, and deprivation; I infer the same extraction logic behind the promised reciprocity. The live alternative is that the garden agents are only an analogy and do not specify the focus opponents' intent.

changed_reading.before: Their matching softness gives equal value for the addressee's concession.
changed_reading.after: Their offer may ration a token response in order to extract the first concession while substantive benefit remains withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches join degree-by-degree taking, extended time, stratagem, and controlled pacing. They strengthen the token-wetting model by turning a slight first concession into degree one of a prolonged operation rather than a self-contained bargain.

activation_trace.role: The slight-wetting branch supplies the deliberately small initial increment from which a staged process can begin.
The accommodation branch supplies the socially acceptable form in which the first increment is requested.
The stepwise-taking branch supplies cumulative capture by degrees and makes the first concession an entry point.
The extended-time branch supplies the temporal span over which an apparently small opening can be exploited.
The stratagem branch supplies concealed sequencing rather than transparent one-step exchange.
The controlled delay in a race supplies tactical pacing and prevents slowness from being mistaken for lack of direction.

structural_cues: 68:44-45 explicitly sequence gradual taking, time extension, strategy, and firmness.
The focus begins with the smallest requested movement and reserves the opponents' move until after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a slight first change, taking by degrees, extended time, stratagem, and pacing; I infer that the requested concession is an opening stage. A live alternative is that the later sequence describes a different agent's strategy and only analogically illuminates the focus.

changed_reading.before: The compromise is a bounded one-for-one exchange.
changed_reading.after: The token concession is potentially degree one of gradual capture, with promised reciprocity functioning as bait and pacing mechanism.

context_deltas.mechanism: Coating in the focus meets later branches of uncovering, exposure, and covering truth. Mutual softening becomes a pact of managed visibility: each side covers the conflict, but the arrangement remains vulnerable to disclosure and can itself participate in obscuring what is true.

activation_trace.role: The applied-coating branch supplies a removable layer that regulates what can be seen.
The dissembling branch gives the layer a social function: concealment of conflict behind pliant behavior.
The uncovering branch supplies removal of a cover and makes the focus coating temporary rather than transformative.
The exposed-flaw branch supplies the disclosure risk concealed by a polished bilateral surface.
The open-uncovered-space branch supplies the state reached when protective or cosmetic covering is absent.
The truth-obscuring branch supplies the epistemic cost of mutual coating: managed visibility can hide more than hostility.

structural_cues: Later context moves through uncovering, exposed open space, and a final truth-covering posture.
The focus repeats the same coating-capable root on both actors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coating, dissembling, uncovering, exposure, and truth-covering; I infer a shared visibility regime rather than inward agreement. The live alternative is that these images refer to unrelated physical and moral scenes.

changed_reading.before: Mutual accommodation settles the disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Mutual accommodation can instead cover the disagreement, leaving both the hidden conflict and the truth beneath it available for later exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late slipping inventory explicitly reconnects oiling and polishing with loss of footing. It activates a hostile function for the focus coating and smooth-road branches: lubrication removes grip, so the requested smoothness can be a means of dislodging the addressee from his station.

activation_trace.role: The oiling branch supplies lubrication and gives the social request a material means of reducing grip.
The smooth-road branch supplies a low-friction surface whose ease can benefit movement while endangering stability.
The slipping-from-position branch supplies the consequence of a surface on which footing cannot hold.
The bodily oiling-and-polishing branch closes the material distance to the focus and makes lubrication operational rather than decorative.
The literal-sight branch supplies the hostile gaze as the delivery channel for the attempted displacement.

structural_cues: The focus asks the addressee to become smooth first; near the close, the opponents nearly make him lose position.
The final hostile act is again linked to the opponents' response to the proclamation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies oiling, smoothness, a surface without secure footing, and attempted displacement; I infer the arrow lubrication to reduced grip to dislodgment. A live alternative is that the late slipping is a standalone metaphor for a hostile gaze with no backward material activation.

changed_reading.before: Smoothness merely lowers interpersonal friction.
changed_reading.after: The requested smoothness may lower the addressee's grip on his station, making reciprocal politeness part of an attempted destabilization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The madness accusation brackets the surah, while the post-focus portrait supplies personal attack, transported slander, and public saying. Their promised softening can therefore be read as a reputational ceasefire offered in exchange for prior softening of the proclamation.

activation_trace.role: The wishing branch supplies solicitation of the change that would purchase relief from attack.
The mirrored social-softening branch supplies both alteration of proclamation and the promised easing of hostile treatment.
The mind-covering madness branch supplies the accusation denied before the focus and establishes reputational pressure.
The fault-finding attack branch supplies direct injury to reputation as a negotiable pressure point.
The slander-carrying branch supplies circulation of hostile speech beyond a private disagreement.
The publicly spreading saying branch supplies the social reach of the closing accusation.
The repeated madness branch closes the bracket and shows that the pressure campaign persists when no first concession is given.

structural_cues: The same madness accusation appears before and near the end of the surah.
The character sketch immediately after the focus moves from personal attack to mobile slander.
The opponents' promised response is left unspecified beyond repeating the same root, so easing their speech remains live.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bracketing accusation, fault-finding, circulating slander, and public speech; I infer that their reciprocal softening includes relaxing the reputational campaign. A live alternative is that both d-h-n verbs concern only doctrinal language, not treatment of the speaker.

changed_reading.before: They offer reciprocal moderation in an abstract debate.
changed_reading.after: They offer a coercive reputational ceasefire: soften the proclamation first, and they will soften the labels and social attack directed at its bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later branches supply imposed burden, self-restraint, held breath or speech, and a blocked outlet. They activate accommodation as a pressure-release offer: external constriction makes softening feel like opening a valve, while the opponents promise to ease only after yielding occurs.

activation_trace.role: The conciliatory-softening branch supplies the proposed release behavior under pressure.
The weakness branch supplies the risk that release is obtained by reducing the speaker's force.
The burdensome-imposition branch supplies external pressure capable of making concession feel relieving.
The self-restraint branch supplies the alternative to pressure-driven release: holding the self steady without premature yielding.
The held-breath and silenced-speech branch supplies internal compression produced by sustained conflict.
The blocked-full-outlet branch supplies the valve-like material model for a concession offered as relief.

structural_cues: Near the close, patience is ordered in contrast with action taken under constriction.
The focus makes the opponents' easing conditional on the addressee releasing first.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burden, restraint, held speech, and a blocked outlet; I infer that opposition pressure makes compromise function psychologically as release. The live alternative is that the later constriction episode is personal and does not illuminate the focus transaction.

changed_reading.before: Accommodation is chosen because it is mutually reasonable.
changed_reading.after: Accommodation can be induced as relief from engineered pressure, with the opponents promising to release pressure only after the speaker's force drops.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later ability, prostration, and humiliation branches give the mirrored softening a vertical and bodily dimension. The focus becomes a contest over who lowers first: the opponents promise responsive yielding but demand the addressee perform the initiating bend.

activation_trace.role: The mutual-softening branch supplies the verbal and social form of lowering.
The weakness branch supplies the opponents' desired reduction in firmness and makes first movement a status loss.
The capability branch supplies the question of whether a demanded lowering can actually be performed.
The abasement branch supplies bodily lowering and turns softening into a struggle over submission.
The breakage-under-compulsion branch supplies the involuntary endpoint against which voluntary first yielding is measured.

structural_cues: The focus grammatically assigns the first lowering to the addressee.
68:42-43 later pair a call to bodily lowering with inability and compelled humiliation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual softness, weakness, capability, bodily abasement, and compelled breakage; I infer a status contest over first submission. A live alternative is that the later prostration scene is ritual and should not be projected onto rhetorical accommodation.

changed_reading.before: The verse seeks a horizontal midpoint between parties.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a vertical contest: they want the addressee to lower first and promise to bend only responsively, preserving their leverage over who yielded.

context_deltas.mechanism: Writing, ordered line, binding judgment, and record branches create a fixed public norm. Against them, oiling and dissembling can function as smearing or glossing that fixed line until it appears negotiable without openly erasing it.

activation_trace.role: The smearing branch supplies an applied layer capable of changing how a fixed surface is presented.
The dissembling branch converts material smearing into rhetorical treatment that leaves a contrary commitment beneath the presentation.
The prepared writing instrument supplies the production of an accountable fixed record.
The ordered written line supplies stable articulated content that coating would affect at the level of legibility or presentation.
The exact-and-secure branch supplies firmness of judgment against which rhetorical negotiability is measured.
The binding-record branch supplies a norm that obligates rather than merely pleases its audience.

structural_cues: The surah opens with writing and later challenges the opponents to produce a book supporting their judgment.
The focus asks for altered handling of the proclamation rather than offering a replacement record.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, ordered line, binding record, secure judgment, coating, and dissembling; I infer an attempt to make fixed content publicly negotiable by changing its presentation. The packet does not say oil touches text, so literal smearing remains an analogy and the alternative is ordinary diplomatic phrasing.

changed_reading.before: They ask only for a gentler interpersonal tone.
changed_reading.after: They ask that an accountable fixed proclamation be handled as negotiable display, softened in presentation without openly replacing its record.

It remains anchored in the doubled focus root and gains context from pushing and striking branches; downstream prose should present it only as a low-confidence lexical shadow of managed coercion, never as the grammatical gloss.

The prodding-and-driving branch supplies force calibrated to move a target rather than openly destroy it.
The striking branch supplies the harder coercive continuum against which the focus idiom appears deliberately light.

changed_reading.before: They seek mutual gentleness instead of force.
changed_reading.after: As a contained lexical shadow, they may seek conversion of open conflict into reciprocal, deniable low-intensity coercion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it carries surface rain, weak yield, dew, and interrupted flow into a social verb. surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated root at words 3-4 includes both slight surface wetting and diminished productive strength, so the mirrored action can be modeled as rationed nourishment.

activation_trace.role: The slight-rain branch supplies moisture that changes appearance without guaranteeing deep or productive saturation.
The low-yield branch supplies reduced generative output and makes the exchange quantitatively meager.
The small weak water branch supplies a context analogue for an offered response too slight to fertilize change.
The dew-and-moisture branch supplies a thin beneficial layer and keeps the token-wetting image live inside the garden sequence.
The cut-off rain or yield branch supplies intentional interruption of the productive flow that token moisture only simulates.

changed_reading.after: As an ecological analogy, the opponents ask for the first visible wetting while promising only matched traces of moisture, keeping the exchange below productive depth.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 carries a remote stake-or-peg branch, and words 3-4 carry coating and smoothing branches, allowing the desired event to cast a lexical shadow of lubricating a fixed anchor.

activation_trace.role: The dialectal peg branch supplies a fixed anchor whose displacement can materialize loss of firmness.
The oiling branch supplies lubrication applied to the anchor and provides the means of loosening it.
The smooth-surface branch supplies reduced friction around what had been fixed.
The slipping-from-station branch supplies the resulting loss of anchorage and gives the remote peg image a contextual endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They desire mutual rhetorical softness.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, they desire that a fixed anchor be oiled loose first, after which their own movement becomes possible.

strongest_changes: The mirrored verb is asymmetrical: the addressee must advance the first concession while the opponents' return remains conditional.
Path, obedience, assay, and gradual-taking branches turn a polite bargain into a probe that can pave a misdirected course and open a staged capture.
The late oiling-and-slipping activation gives smoothness a hostile mechanics: reduced friction can mean reduced footing and attempted displacement.
Bracketing madness accusations and the slander network recast the offer as a reputational ceasefire exchanged for softening the proclamation.
Separate peace, truthful-affection, and reconciliation branches preserve a distinction between genuine repair and mutually coated appearances.
summary.what_was_special: One exact repeated focus root sustained social, material, spatial, ecological, legal, and bodily mechanisms without forcing them into one verdict. The most productive surprise was that smoothness has two opposed affordances: it eases passage for another actor while also removing the first actor's grip.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal link clearly orders the two actions, but it does not by itself decide whether the opponents' response is a sincere promise, an expected consequence, or bait.
Physical branches of d-h-n visibly activate coating, wetting, weakness, and smoothness, but their distance from the finite verbal use varies and requires different levels of containment.
The context strongly supplies recurring social mechanisms, yet not every later agent or strategy must be identical with the opponents in the focus.
The affection branch of w-d-d may indicate genuine desire for affiliation, manipulative conditional belonging, or only a latent overtone beside the ordinary wishing sense.
The lexical contrast between accommodation and later peace or reconciliation is abductively useful but is not proof that the semantic fields cannot overlap.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Reciprocal compromise as surface softening.** `و د د B002` gives wishing, and the mirrored verbs activate `د ه ن B002` (conciliatory compromise or dissembling). The conditional sequence makes their softening follow his. I infer his concession -> their reciprocal concession; the ayah exposes an exchange mechanism rather than a one-sided appeal for kindness.
2. **An oily coating over unresolved difference.** `د ه ن B001` supplies oil and smearing, while `د ه ن B011` supplies visible traces of prosperity. The packet later contrasts exposed marks (68:16), uncovered reality (68:42), and a smooth slipping attack by eyes (68:51, `ز ل ق B001/B007`). I infer that social compromise can coat a surface without repairing the underlying opposition. The ayah therefore preserves a material image of polished agreement whose smoothness makes firmness difficult.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:51's slipping gaze unexpectedly reactivates the material oil/smoothness image: when reciprocal softening fails, hostile sight attempts to remove footing. 68:45's prolonged matching (`م ت ن B007`) also shows that apparent mutuality can conceal an asymmetrical temporal contest.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Compromise as mutual surface-smoothing.** Both fixed `تُدْهِنُ / يُدْهِنُونَ` activate `د ه ن B001` (oil and smearing), while 68:13-14 supply a marked social appendage, wealth, and sons as visible status signals. The packet supplies reciprocal morphology and polished public standing; I infer that concession is meant to reduce friction and preserve a status-bearing surface. The proposal reads as cosmetic reciprocity that leaves underlying relations untouched.
2. **A wish for affiliative attachment.** Fixed `وَدُّوا` activates `و د د B001` (affection and loving attachment), not only `و د د B002` (wishing). The two matched oil-verbs and the repeated commands to obey in 68:8 and 68:10 supply a desired reciprocal bond; I infer that mutual softening is expected to create loyalty. Their wish therefore seeks incorporation into an affectionate alliance as well as tactical concession.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimlerin yer adı işleviyle sınırlıdır ve aynı yazılışın sevgi, dilek, kazık ya da put anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir çıplak biçimin bilinen bir dağın, aynı köke bağlı başka bir çıplak biçimin ise bilinen bir vadinin özel adı olarak kullanılmasıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal belirli putlara verilmiş özel adı ve bu addan türeyen kişi adını kapsar; putların genel adını veya başka put adlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimdeki put adını çekirdek tutar ve bu addan kurulan kişi adını bağımlı bir kullanım olarak ayırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi hem sürülebilir maddeyi hem de bu maddeyi bir şeye ya da kişinin kendisine sürmesi eylemini açıkça kapsar. Hazırlanmış dal çerçevesi bu ad ve eylem birlikteliğini doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, yağ maddesi ve onunla kaplama eylemiyle sınırlıdır; yumuşak davranma, hafif yağmur ve vurma anlamları bunun dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın biçimlerdeki yağ maddesini ve yağla kaplama eylemini kapsar; başka dallardaki yapıya bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Sıvı ya da sürülebilir bir madde olarak kullanılan yağı ve bir şeyi bu maddeyle kaplama eylemini kapsar. Kişinin kendine yağ sürmesi, aynı eylemin dönüşlü gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdekte, bir yüzeye sürülebilen yağ maddesi bulunur.

Kişinin kendi üzerine yağ sürmesi, kaplama eyleminin dönüşlü biçimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yağın sürülebilir bir madde olduğunu, bir nesneye sürülebileceğini ve kişinin kendisine de uygulayabileceğini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Yağ maddesini, bir yüzeyi yağla kaplamayı ve kişinin kendine yağ sürmesini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Genel yumuşak uzlaşma ile birine karşı içtekini gizleme ayrı yüzlerdir; her yumuşak davranış aldatma sayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin yumuşak uzlaşma anlamı ile belirli kişiye yönelen yapının içtekini gizleme anlamı ayrı yüzlerde tutulur.

facets.statement: Yağış, yerin yalnız yüzünü az miktarda ıslatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade sopayla vurmayı ortak çekirdek olarak verir; hafiflik yalnız bazı aktarımlarda, dolaylı ve alaycı söyleyiş ise başka bir aktarımda belirir. Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat bütün vuruşların zorunlu olarak hafif ve alaycı olduğu söylenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yapıya bağlı temel anlam sopayla vurmaktır; hafif vuruş ile alaycı veya dolaylı anlatım kaynak değişkeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız sopayla kurulan yapıya bağlıdır; buradaki vurma anlamı yalın kökün genel anlamı gibi sunulmaz.

facets.statement: Kurucu eylem, birine sopayla vurmaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade, yağ konan kabı ve buna benzetilerek su tutan kaya ya da dağ oyuğunu açıkça aynı dalda birleştirir. Hazırlanmış çerçeve kap ile doğal oyuk arasındaki benzetmeye dayalı genişlemeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili ifade önce az süt veren dişi deveyi verir, kişi ve iş için güçsüzlük kullanımını ise bunun yanında genişletilmiş bir kullanım olarak tanıklar. Hazırlanmış çerçeve geçerlidir, ancak güçsüzlük süt azlığıyla eş düzey tek bir çekirdek gibi sunulmamalıdır.

facets.statement: Temel kullanım, dişi devenin sütünün az olmasıdır.

Aynı ses biçimi belirli bir kadın adı içinde de tanıklanır.

The upstream aligned_qac_word_ref is preserved verbatim in word_analysis and is NOT corrected here -- renumbering would fabricate identities (PRINCIPLES.md §11 / basmalah no-hidden-renumbering rule). Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Word-level joins between word_analysis topics and QAC morphology are UNRELIABLE here. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

missing_branch_inventories.reason: no accepted, non-contaminated branch inventory in resource

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

butuncul_okuma.note: no whole-surah reading file exists for this surah

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.
